Asset: production game HUD ability icon atlas, single square sheet, exactly 4 columns by 6 rows of 24 equal square painted icons, no margins between cells, no text, no letters. Each cell a DIFFERENT distinct ability symbol with controlled glow and rich dimensional rendering. No character portraits, no lettering, no grids drawn on top. Exact uniform grid essential for slicing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production isometric action survival RPG sprite atlas on genuinely transparent background. Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows of equally sized square cells, all 12 characters isolated with generous 15% empty cell padding. Same original character in all 12 cells: original petite rabbit-eared pop singer mage with flowing pink hair, turquoise and pink stage outfit, small floating musical microphone staff; no gun, no humanoid sexualization. Camera elevated 55 degrees, facing southeast in every frame, feet at consistent ground baseline, character size identical. Row 1 four subtle idle breathing frames. Row 2 four consecutive distinct walking frames showing alternate feet and arm swing. Row 3 four consecutive attack/cast frames, windup, release, follow-through, recovery. Fully rendered polished colorful painterly 3D game art with readable silhouettes and clean material highlights. NO floor, NO ground shadows, NO scenery, NO labels, NO text, NO borders, NO detached particles outside cells. Fixed scale and alignment crucial for animation. Atlas is square and every cell is width/4 and height/3.
